summary: Implemented revision-aware event-time window aggregation with idempotent replays, atomic finalization checks, and sorted nonempty output windows.
tests_run: node test runner: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs (5 passed, 0 failed)
Covered negative-time window anchoring, revision replacement and replay, zero totals, final-window rejection, watermark monotonicity, and same-revision conflicts.
limitations: Uses JavaScript Number arithmetic for integer timestamps and totals; values beyond the safe-integer range are subject to normal Number precision limits.
